title.narrative: Crecer Sano Guatemala Nutrition and Health Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to (i) improve selected practices, services and behaviors known to be key determinants of chronic malnutrition (with an emphasis on the first 1,000 days of life), and (ii) respond to the threat posed by COVID-19, in selected intervention areas.
